navier_fit.pioneer_ii: Pioneer II owns the local tour-tender tier — León Dormido (~9 nm), Cerro Brujo, the SCY airport transfer — all inside the 70 nm all-electric envelope on protected lee water.
navier_fit.quanta_lr: N35 Shuttle is the inter-island commuter platform — San Cristóbal↔Santa Cruz (~40 nm), San Cristóbal↔Isabela (~70 nm). Hybrid Quanta-LR is the longer-horizon Galápagos↔mainland Ecuador trunk option.

precedents.why_it_matters: San Cristóbal is the eastern leg of the same three-port triangle — paired build with Santa Cruz, not standalone.

regulatory_note: Same Galápagos National Park (DPNG) + Ministerio del Ambiente y Agua regime as Santa Cruz — strictest decarbonisation regulatory tailwind in the Navier backlog. UNESCO World Heritage marine reserve.
seasonality: Year-round operability; cool/dry season (June–November) brings stronger SE trades and more chop, which foiling handles cleanly. Warm/wet season (December–May) is calmer and tourist-peak.

summary: San Cristóbal (Puerto Baquerizo Moreno) is the provincial capital of Galápagos and a primary air gateway, anchoring the eastern leg of the inter-island triangle. It shares the same UNESCO marine-reserve decarbonisation tailwind as Santa Cruz — slightly lower standalone demand but essential to the hub-and-spoke spine. Pioneer II covers the local lobos-and-leon-dormido tour transfers; N35 Shuttle covers the cross-archipelago legs to Santa Cruz and Isabela.
tagline: Eastern leg of the Galápagos triangle — provincial capital + primary air gateway with the same UNESCO decarbonisation tailwind.
